...according to Nobel laureate [Myron Scholes](http://www.nytimes.com/2009/05/17/magazine/17wwln-q4-t.html?_r=1&sq=Myron%20Scholes&st=nyt&scp=1&pagewanted=print "Myron Scholes") of Platinum Grove Asset Management:

> *One of my partners is Chinese, and he said we needed a name that had one metal in it and one wood.*
